text: <font=clinker:serif_soft><color=534337>    Palombara is, by all accounts, a fool - but a fool who works quickly. Before I, or any of the synod could manage a practical remedy, the first gate had been readied. How Palombara, the folly of wise Ostanes, could conjure a capable design is beyond my mastery. Soon, the vizier will grant him a host of thralls and three masters from the claymakers guild. I imagine there is little we can do now to stall their dissent.

The majority of the synod believes we are acting too hastily, but there are some who say nothing at all - in silent agreement, no doubt, with Palombara. I do not understand it! Is it not as bright as the stars? Our very nature grows corrupted. We are not a warring people, yet rashness prevails. Our banners are raised ever higher, our armies train for an enemy we have not met. I am afraid.
In any case, I shall continue my search. Presently, I follow the writings of Hofni, but the records in Sura seem incomplete. Nevertheless, these mirrors appear promising, though it will take time.
